verdict.rationale: Mastercard Open Finance ships developer-facing tooling (API client libraries, an official MCP server and agent toolkit), so whether users can opt out of telemetry is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or any opt-out control. The cited docs cover data-aggregation APIs, webhooks, onboarding and the MCP toolkit only.
